## Public code

- [Domowy Skarbnik](https://github.com/sebastian-kostecki/household-treasurer): A yearly household budget: plan vs actual, liquidity across accounts and term deposits, and CSV/XLSX statement import from mBank and BNP Paribas.
- [Root Keeper](https://github.com/sebastian-kostecki/root-keeper): A family tree where every date has a source. People, relationships and scanned records that confirm births, marriages and deaths.
- [Menu Maker](https://github.com/sebastian-kostecki/menu-maker): A family's weekly meal plan from your own recipes: ingredients scaled to the household with AI and one PDF with the plan and the shopping list.
